core.headline: Two-bedroom first-floor flat in Chatham with allocated parking
core.listing:
A two-bedroom first-floor purpose-built flat on New Road in Chatham, with an allocated parking space and lift access. The property is held on a 99-year leasehold with a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026).

The open-plan kitchen/living room has a Juliet balcony. There are two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside, there is one allocated parking space.

The flat is offered at a guide price of £195,000 and is held leasehold with 99 years remaining; the service charge is £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax is Band B (Medway Council) and the EPC rating is C. The property has standard construction, mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband is FTTC and there is good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues are none known.
